inference.a_r6_native_resolution: same frozen normalized coverage, container, boundary, calibration, margin, and tie-break rules evaluated at native Realsense HxW without resizing
inference.geometry_support: union of FastSAM proposals passing every frozen A-R6 non-CAD filter
inference.geometry_instances: robust raw-depth edge components followed by marker watershed inside support
inference.sam2_role: mask refinement only; geometry supplies instance count and prompts
inference.sam2_prompting: one positive geometry seed, every other geometry seed as negative, geometry bounding box
inference.cad_role: causal keep-or-drop decision, not diagnostic-only ranking
inference.cad_threshold: leave-one-scene-out threshold selected on the other four consumed scenes

decisions.retain_sam2: paired frame-F1 delta lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0, at least 4/5 scenes improve, AP50 and PQ do not decrease
decisions.retain_cad: CAD AUROC lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0.5, paired frame-F1 delta lower bound > 0, at least 4/5 scenes improve, AP50 and PQ do not decrease
decisions.route_positive: best successor beats both A-R6 and raw-FastSAM diagnostics in paired F1 with lower bound > 0 and does not reduce AP50 or PQ
decisions.route_failure_action: switch to a true instance detector/segmenter or 3D instance proposal family
decisions.scene9_action: never replay in A-R8; only a later physically-correct synthetic successor may authorize one replay
